# Content Seeding (Tier 0)

Seed the platform with high-quality curated content to create initial network effects.

Acceptance criteria:
- 50–100 product images uploaded with metadata (title, designer, price placeholder).
- 20–30 creator posts created and linked to product items where possible.
- 10–15 curated designer profiles created with bios and sample collections.

Success metric: 50+ product items and 20+ creator posts exist in staging.
